Definition: from G1772 and the base of G1507; to enwrap:--wrap in.
BiblicalUsage: Joseph of Arimathaea bought fine linen, took Jesus down, and wrapped Him in the linen in Mark 15:46, and laid Him in a tomb hewn out of rock.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe there is tenderness in this wrapping — a stranger's hands doing for Jesus what His own disciples had fled from — and love still finds work to do even at the grave.
